source.name: Samoa Observer: 'Federal Pacific commits $3M to Lakapi Samoa'
source.quote: Federal Pacific Insurance Samoa has committed $3 million over the next two years as the major sponsor of Lakapi Samoa
source.note: Major sponsor of Lakapi Samoa, covering Manu Samoa, from May 2026. The 'FEDPAC INSURANCE' logo sits centre-front of the 2026 home jersey, visible at full resolution on the official Dynasty Sport product images (dynastysport.co.nz/products/manu-samoa-adults-2026-replica-home-jersey, front and angled views) and in Samoa Observer Nations Cup match photos of 12 and 19 July 2026.

source.name: Samoa Observer: 'Discipline costs Samoa as Romania claim first Nations Cup win'
source.quote: Romania secured its first Nations Cup win with a 38-37 result at Estadio Charrúa in Montevideo, Uruguay
source.note: The match photos published with this Samoa Observer Nations Cup report (World Rugby photography) show the white 'ria Money Transfer' logo on the sleeves of the blue home jersey; the logo is also on both sleeves of the official replica images at dynastysport.co.nz/products/manu-samoa-adults-2026-replica-home-jersey (text wraps the sleeve edge). Lakapi Samoa's sponsors page (lakapisamoa.com/sponsors) lists Ria, logo file 'Ria_Secondary_Logo_Descriptor_Color_RGB.png' linking to riamoneytransfer.com.

source.name: Samoa Observer: 'Discipline costs Samoa as Romania claim first Nations Cup win'
source.quote: Romania secured its first Nations Cup win with a 38-37 result at Estadio Charrúa in Montevideo, Uruguay
source.note: The match photos published with this Samoa Observer Nations Cup report (World Rugby photography) show the script logo 'Matniuel Est 2011' under the number on the upper back of the home jersey; the same logo appears on the back view of the official replica images at dynastysport.co.nz/products/manu-samoa-adults-2026-replica-home-jersey. Matniuel is a screen-printing and signs business in Apia, est. 2011, also listed on lakapisamoa.com/sponsors.

source.name: Samoa Observer: 'Discipline costs Samoa as Romania claim first Nations Cup win'
source.quote: Romania secured its first Nations Cup win with a 38-37 result at Estadio Charrúa in Montevideo, Uruguay
source.note: The match photos published with this Samoa Observer Nations Cup report (World Rugby photography) show the red 'Coca-Cola' script logo on the back of the left leg of the white match shorts. Coca-Cola (and Powerade) logos are also listed on lakapisamoa.com/sponsors.

source.name: Samoa Observer: 'Discipline costs Samoa as Romania claim first Nations Cup win'
source.quote: Romania secured its first Nations Cup win with a 38-37 result at Estadio Charrúa in Montevideo, Uruguay
source.note: The match photos published with this Samoa Observer Nations Cup report (World Rugby photography) show the Eveni Pacific logo (green palm frond over script 'Eveni') on the white match shorts; a small green logo in the same position is visible on the front view in the Samoa Observer's 12 July 2026 report photo of the Samoa v Georgia Siva Tau. The logo matches the 'eveni.png' logo on lakapisamoa.com/sponsors.

source.name: Talamua Online: 'Lakapi Samoa Launches New Kit Partnership with Dynasty Sport'
source.quote: Lakapi Samoa has signed a three-year partnership with Dynasty Sport, that is now the official apparel partner for Manu Samoa from 2025 to 2027
source.note: Kit maker, not a shirt sponsor; listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. Dynasty Sport's own shop sells the 'Manu Samoa Adults 2026 Replica Home Jersey' and its August 2026 blog post '2026 Manu Samoa Range' calls Dynasty 'the Official Apparel Partner of Lakapi Samoa'.

summary: The 2026 home jersey (blue, made by Dynasty Sport, official apparel partner of Manu Samoa 2025-2027) carries FedPac Insurance centre-front, the Ria Money Transfer logo on both sleeves and the script logo 'Matniuel Est 2011' under the number on the upper back; the white match shorts carry Coca-Cola and Eveni Pacific leg logos and the Samoa flag patch sits at the back of the neck (not a sponsor). Every placement checked: official Dynasty Sport replica product images at full resolution (front, angled and back views) and World Rugby match photos published with the Samoa Observer's Nations Cup 2026 reports (Siva Tau front view vs Georgia, 12 July; try-celebration back view vs Romania, 19 July).
headline: The shirt is {level}: FedPac Insurance on the front, Ria Money Transfer on the sleeves, Matniuel on the back, Coca-Cola and Eveni on the shorts. Dynasty Sport made the kit.
shortLine: FedPac front, Ria sleeves, Matniuel back, Coca-Cola + Eveni shorts
